profile.headline: Software Engineer at American Airlines
profile.summary: A creative, ambitious, full stack developer with a passion for front-end development and UI Design. Multiple projects using React or Angular with Node.js/Express. Experience with working on a team and helping members complete their code and goals. Actively pursuing opportunities to provide programming skills, leadership ability, and enthusiasm to a fast-paced environment as a full stack developer.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Provided user-friendly interfaces for websites and mobile apps using Typescript. Improved user experience by fixing front-end and back-end defects. Helped satisfy new business demands by creating and updating APIs with C#. Improved application resiliency by remediating their vulnerabilities.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Developed user interfaces per client-provided needs and requirements using Vue.js. Provided data needed by the client through out the application using APIs. Created crud operations to provide the user the ability to get, add, update, and delete data. Communicated with and gathered feedback from customers about progress updates and worked to resolve concerns. Collaborated with members to define and develop new product concepts.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Created lessons with interactive questions, page locks, and responsive grading for online k-12 students. Designed API specs for lessons. Used React to build admin interface with Mongo for user validation.
